name: cap7ce
description: Windows local asset search, browsing and preview with a native WinUI shell and independent Core.
author: 7C93F3-L

scripts.build:core: cross-env DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 dotnet build core/Cap7CE.Core.sln --configuration Release --nologo
scripts.publish:core-setup: cross-env DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 dotnet publish core/src/Cap7CE.Core.Setup/Cap7CE.Core.Setup.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true --nologo --output core/artifacts/publish/Cap7CE.Core.Setup -p:RestoreLockedMode=true
scripts.test:source: node scripts/native-source-check.cjs && npm run test:architecture && node scripts/winui-shell-boundary-check.cjs
scripts.test:core: npm run test:core-restore-profiles && dotnet run --project core/tests/Cap7CE.Core.Tests/Cap7CE.Core.Tests.csproj -c Release
scripts.test:runtime: node tests/animation-fact.integration.cjs && node tests/archive-metadata-reader.integration.cjs && node tests/image-metadata-inspector.integration.cjs && node tests/video-metadata-frames.integration.cjs && node tests/llama-runtime-idle.integration.cjs && node tests/three-d-known-properties.integration.cjs && node tests/metadata-extractor-manifest.integration.cjs && node tests/core-directory-sort.integration.cjs && node tests/core-model-settings.integration.cjs && node tests/pdf-thumbnail-native.integration.cjs && node tests/exr-native.integration.cjs && node tests/core-visual-execution-lifetime.integration.cjs && node tests/metadata-runtime.integration.cjs && node tests/native-providers.integration.cjs && node tests/native-update.integration.cjs && node tests/resource-catalog.integration.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:source && npm run test:layout && npm run test:browse && npm run test:core && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:delivery: npm run test:core-setup-native && npm run test:core-capability-payload && node scripts/native-installer-smoke.cjs && node scripts/native-install-lifecycle-smoke.cjs && node scripts/native-uninstall-lifecycle-smoke.cjs && node scripts/native-installer-flow-smoke.cjs
